subject: BYM2 Phi=1 even with strict PC prior

messages.author: 7a0c0a1d5af6ca55
messages.subject: BYM2 Phi=1 even with strict PC prior
parts:
Greetings INLA family,

I have an INLA model (fitted via inlabru), with the following:

comps <- ~ Intercept(1) + droughtIndex(droughtIndex) + traveltime(traveltime) + dist2water(dist2water) + precipitation(precipitation) + sanitation(sanitation) + 
  bym2_incidence(loc_data_id, model = "bym2", graph = graph_ward,
                 scale.model = T, hyper = area_bym2_prior) +

incidence_model <- bru_obs(
  family = "nzpoisson"
  , data = data
 
  , formula = incidence ~Intercept + droughtIndex + traveltime + dist2water + precipitation + sanitation + bym2_incidence,

  , E = (data$population)
  , options = list(safe = T)
)

I proceeded to set strict priors on the bym2_effect (as my thinking is the spatial effect should not contribute much in the presence of many covariates which I expect to explain majority of the variability in the response; I hope this is the right thinking)

# setting prior as Pr(phi < 0.5) = 0.95

area_bym2_prior <- list(
  prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)), 
  phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(.5, 0.95))              
)

The model results show this:
Model hyperparameters:
                              mean    sd 0.025quant 0.5quant 0.975quant  mode
Precision for bym2_incidence 0.157 0.009       0.14    0.157      0.176 0.156
Phi for bym2_incidence       1.000 0.000       1.00    1.000      1.000 1.000

Is this a red-flag when the BYM2 phi is estimated as 1, Is it something I should be worried about, and look for ways to correct ?


NB: Setting a stricter PC prior of phi using (u, alpha)=(0.5, 0.99) makes the phi to be estimated as 0.2

Thank you in advance.
